pages.text: There are a few sweet things in Moon's Whatsits too.$(br2)Some of them use fruit from the crops in this mod, while others are a bit less ordinary.

pages.title: Desserts
pages.text: The desserts are Apple Pie, Cherry Pie, Mooncake and Strawberry Ice Cream.$(br2)Most of these give some of the fruit crops another use once you've harvested them.

Cutting cakes and pies:$(br)Use the Bakery Bread Knife on a whole cake, pie, tart or pudding block to turn it into slices.$(br2)The knife works on Strawberry Cake, Sweetberry Cake, Chocolate Cake, Bundt Cake, Linzer Tart, Apple Pie, Glowberry Tart, Pudding, Chocolate Gateau and Chocolate Tart.
